description: This Java class 'ContentType' parses and represents content-type headers, providing details on how Ditto should handle payloads based on content type. It includes predefined constants, regex patterns for type matching, and parsing strategies.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates the parsing and interpretation of content-type header values, determining parsing strategies such as text, JSON, or binary, and providing utility methods for content-type handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to parse a content-type string into a ContentType instance, determining the parsing strategy based on regex pattern matching.

methods.name: getParsingStrategy
methods.description: Returns the parsing strategy (TEXT, JSON, BINARY) associated with this content type.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the original content-type string value.

methods.name: isDittoProtocol
methods.description: Checks if the content-type matches the Ditto protocol content type.

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Checks if the content-type should be parsed as text.

methods.name: isJson
methods.description: Checks if the content-type should be parsed as JSON.

methods.name: isBinary
methods.description: Checks if the content-type should be parsed as binary.
